candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return msg.sender instead of the stored _owner, making returned owner caller-dependent.
Change owner() to always return the zero address instead of the stored _owner.
Change owner() to return the contract's address instead of the stored _owner.
Removed the check that newOwner is non-zero, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to zero address.
Added a require reversing check to forbid any non-zero newOwner, only allowing transfer to zero address (effectively only allowing renounce via transferOwnership).
Changed onlyOwner to check caller is NOT the owner, inverting the access control so transferOwnership becomes callable by non-owners.
Relaxed onlyOwner to allow any caller (removed the owner check), making transferOwnership callable by anyone.
Set rewardDistributor to the zero address instead of the provided _distributor.
Assign rewardDistributor to msg.sender rather than the provided _distributor.
Do not change rewardDistributor (remove assignment), leaving it unchanged after the call.
Set rewardDistributor to the previous owner instead of the provided _distributor.
Change onlyOwner check to compare against tx.origin instead of _msgSender(), allowing different caller to pass and thus affecting who can change rewardDistributor.
